name: B10-0500/2025 – After § 31 – Am 13
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: 31b. Stresses, however, that working conditions in warehousing and delivery are deteriorating, leading to massive staff turnover despite the increasing demand for labour in the sector; stresses the significant challenges to workers’ rights faced by logistics workers, including unregulated subcontracting, precarious and atypical working arrangements, discrimination and barriers faced by migrant workers, violations of remuneration agreements, and non-compliance with working time regulations and with occupational health and safety standards; underlines the importance of addressing these challenges in order to effectively protect EU consumers against illegal products and material;
